name: Laddu Gopal Online Services Limited
summary: Established in 1993, Laddu Gopal Online Services Limited is an Indian firm specializing in real estate development and infrastructure projects. The company's operations encompass the creation and management of various facilities, including software technology centers, multimedia production hubs, and information technology parks, among other related ventures. Previously known as ETT Limited, the company officially rebranded to Laddu Gopal Online Services Limited in February 2025. Its main office is located in Noida, India.
